posts.caption:
MENVA, in one sentence: scan the QR on your table, tap a dish, and the exact plate, same size, same everything, shows up on your own table before you order it.

No app. No download. Safari ya Chrome mein hi khul jata hai.

Yeh menu ki tasveer nahi, asli plate ka 3D scan hai. Jo dikhega, wahi aayega.

Build your list, show the waiter, order with confidence, the waiter still takes the order, we just help you decide.

Try it tonight (link in bio), or send this to the friend who takes 20 minutes to order. You know the one.

posts.caption:
Ordering for eight without the group chat descending into chaos. A short, tested method:

1. One person holds the menu, seriously, just one.
2. Sharing plates first.
3. See the portion before you commit.
4. One extra dish, not five "just in case."
5. Build one list. Show the waiter.

Aik banda menu pakre, baaki chup.

slides.h: Group of eight. *One order, not eight arguments.*
